question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

His gray, __lifeless__ eyes were sunken.
solution:
The correct answer is "**vibrant**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word "lifeless" suggests that the eyes lack energy or vitality.**(निष्प्राण)

 
 
• ​Example: She had a dull and lifeless face.
 
 
 
 
 
• The antonym of "lifeless" would be a word that conveys energy or vitality.
 
• **Among the given options, "Vibrant" fits this description, as it means full of energy and life**.(जीवंत)
 
 
• ​Example: The colour of the rose was vibrant and red.
 
 
 
• Thus, the antonym of the word "lifeless" is "vibrant."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "Extinct" means no longer in existence, and is not an appropriate antonym for "lifeless."(विलुप्त)
 
• Option 2: "Lapsed" means expired or no longer valid, and is not an appropriate antonym for "lifeless."(कालातीत)
 
• Option 4: "Pointed" means sharp or focused, and is not an appropriate antonym for "lifeless."(नुकीला)
